text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

CORN SALES - Taiwan's CK group bought 54,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 corn from Agrex Wednesday, but passed on another 54,000 tonnes, traders said. The deal included 33,500 tonnes for Sept 5-20 from the U.S. Gulf or Sept 21-Oct 5 from the Pacific Northwest (PNW) at $121.80 per tonne, C and F, and 20,500 for Sept 5-20 from the Gulf or Sept 21-Oct 5 from the PNW at 80.37 US cents over the CBOT Sept. It passed on 54,000 tonne tender for Oct 5-20 or Oct 21-Nov 5 from the PNW.

CORN SALES - Taiwan's MFIG bought 56,000 tonnes of US No.2 corn, with an option for an another 4,000 tonnes from Toepfer, traders said. The deal included Sept 7-21 shipment from the Gulf or Sept 22-Oct 6 from the PNW at $121.00, C and F.

WHEAT SALES - South Korea's Daehan Flour Mills Co Ltd bought 22,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from Marubeni. Shipment was for Sept 20-Oct 20 to Inchon. The deal included 6,500 tonnes of western white or soft white wheat at $134.45 per tonne, FOB; 1,000 western white wheat at $135.20; 7,800 hard red winter (11.5 percent protein), at $138.90; and 6,700 dark northern spring at $168.65.

SOYBEAN TENDER - South Korea's state-run Agricultural and Fishery Marketing Corp on July 15 will seek 40,000 tonnes of No.1 soybeans. It seeks 20,000 tonnes for September 20 arrival at Inchon and 20,000 tonnes for arrival by October 20.
WHEAT TENDER - CCC on July 9 will tender to buy 35,000 tonnes of hard red winter for donation to Tajikistan. Shipment was scheduled for July 23 to August 7.

RICE TENDER - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs will receive offers until July 23 to buy 24,000 tonnes of white rice for August delivery, a GEZA spokesman said. Results would be available on July 24.

VEGETABLE OIL TENDER - Egypt's state Holding Company for Food Industries on July 16 will seek 25,000 to 40,000 tonnes of cotton seed, sunflower seed and soybean oils for delivery in August. The tender includes 10,000 to 15,000 tonnes of crude sunflower seed oil and/or semi-refined cotton seed oil and/or American cottonseed oil PBSY 162 for arrival in the first half of August, 1997. - The same amounts and types of oil for second-half August arrival. Also, 5,000 to 10,000 tonnes of degummed soya bean oil second-half August arrival.

MARKET TALK - The United States on Wednesday was considering more food aid for North Korea following a new appeal by the U.N. World Food Program, and officials said another American contribution was all but certain...A key House panel on Wednesday approved a $270 million spending cap on the U.S.'s main export subsidy program in fiscal 1998 despite a world trade agreement that would allow much more...U.S. grain exporters said they had received no indications that Egypt would announce a tender for U.S. wheat but most said they did not expect one this week as Egypt's domestic harvest was continuing. CBOT soft red winter wheat futures jumped in morning trade on Wednesday on widespread talk that Egypt would seek up to 750,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, possibly for Sept/Oct shipment.
